title: Canvas Regression Reel
user: Solo browser-game developers who need visual evidence of rendering regressions, not just headless logic tests and a pile of manual screenshots.
smallest_useful_product: An npm recorder/reporter for browser canvas games: capture a seeded input trace, render checkpoint PNGs, compare tolerantly, and emit a self-contained HTML reel.
success_measure: On a seeded demo, the tool identifies the first changed checkpoint and creates a reviewable report in CI under two minutes.
constraints: Require deterministic seed hooks where possible; mask user-supplied assets in reports; make pixel tolerance explicit; never upload build artifacts by default.
